trap.label: estrutura condicional
trap.wrong: If a theory would be compatible with everything, it would explain nothing.
trap.right: Were a theory compatible with everything, it would explain nothing.
trap.why: Português usa “se fosse” no subjuntivo; em inglês formal a inversão Were + sujeito + to dispensa if, e would não entra após if.

opts: If a rule would be absolute, it binds us.
Were a rule absolute, it would bind us.
Had she known, she would have left.

mcq.q: After “Had she known”, the result uses…

fix.wrong: Were a rule to be absolute, it bind us.
fix.right: Were a rule absolute, it would bind us.

fix.wrong: Had I know, I would have called.
fix.right: Had I known, I would have called.

fix.wrong: If were he honest, he would speak.
fix.right: Were he honest, he would speak.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If a rule were absolute, it would bind us.”
rewrite.answer: Were a rule absolute, it would bind us.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If she had known, she would have left.”
rewrite.answer: Had she known, she would have left.

rewrite.prompt: Negativo: “Were he honest, he would speak.”
rewrite.answer: Were he not honest, he would not speak.
